blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers, hard seltzers, and rotating Rocktails in the taproom. The brewery offers private room rentals for events with capacities up to 100 people. Food trucks are available almost every night, and guests can bring their own 750 ml bottle of wine for a set-up fee.
extraNote: Outside drinks prohibited except 750 ml wine bottle with $8 set-up fee · No reservations for tables; only private room rentals available
